name: Protein N- and O-glycan synthesis with fucosylated selectin ligands
rationale: Members cover N- and O-glycan assembly, fucose/GDP-fucose and blood-group antigen synthesis; unlike the nucleotide-sugar/sialic-acid and GAG confusables, the theme carries fucosylation plus selectin-ligand context (tyrosine sulfation, leukocyte rolling, HSC homing).

core: Antigen presentation via MHC class II
name: MHC class II and lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are exogenous-peptide MHC class II presentation (incl. germinal centre B cells) plus general and lipid/MHC Ib presentation, the lipid/TLR7-8 component separating it from the regulatory class II confusables and class II from the CD1/DC-receptor confusable.

name: Axonal cargo transport with tubulin glutamylation and severing
rationale: Members are kinesin-driven axo-dendritic transport of vesicles, mitochondria and receptors together with tubulin C-terminal polyglutamylation/deglutamylation and microtubule severing, which none of the organelle-transport confusables contain.

name: Macrophage cholesterol efflux and foam cell formation
rationale: Members concern ABCA1/LXR-driven cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and cholesterol storage/import in macrophages, with foam cell differentiation and oxLDL response distinguishing it from the lipoprotein remodeling and reverse-transport confusables.

name: Inherited adrenal cytochrome P450 steroidogenesis defects
rationale: All members are disorders from defective adrenal steroidogenic CYPs (CYP11A1, CYP17A1, CYP21A2, CYP11B1, CYP11B2), whereas confusables are normal sex-steroid or mineralocorticoid biosynthesis processes.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
name: Eye morphogenesis of lens, anterior segment and hyaloid vasculature
rationale: Members span eye development (optic cup, retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, optic nerve) with lens transparency/gap junctions and hyaloid vessel regression distinguishing it from photoreceptor/retinal-neuron and retinal-vascular confusables.

name: Common gamma- and beta-chain cytokine STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9 (common gamma chain) and IL-3, IL-5 (beta-common) signaling with SHC/STAT5 and G-CSF inactivation, distinct from T-cell/IL-15/21, FLT3-STAT5 and IL-6/STAT3 confusables.

name: Glutamate and glutamine metabolism with aromatic acid conjugation
rationale: Members center on glutamate/glutamine/aspartate nitrogen metabolism, plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which separates it from proline/glycine, alanine-gluconeogenesis and generic organic-acid confusables.

name: Regulation of Fas and TRAIL death receptor apoptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL-triggered apoptosis and its positive/negative regulation (BID activation, T-cell AICD, thymocyte and hepatocyte apoptosis), whereas confusables center on caspase-8/c-FLIP complex steps and T-cell signaling.

name: RhoA/B/C subfamily GTPase cycle
rationale: All three members are GTPase cycles of RHOA, RHOB and RHOC, distinguishing the theme from RAC, CDC42 and atypical Rho confusables.

name: Oxidative and nitrosative stress response with ROS detoxification
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, NO, reactive nitrogen and ischemia, ROS detoxification, HMOX1/BACH1 and ferroptosis, distinct from confusables about mitochondrial respiration control and oxidative-stress apoptosis.

name: Craniofacial, limb, pharyngeal gland and spleen development
rationale: Members are face, palate, outer ear, limb and digit morphogenesis plus thyroid, parathyroid, thymus and spleen development, the organ components separating it from head-patterning, neural-crest outflow-tract and nose confusables.

name: CHD and NuRD nucleosome remodeling and assembly
rationale: Members are nucleosome organization, replication-dependent assembly and disassembly with CHD subfamilies and NuRD-associated factors, which distinguishes them from BAF, DNA-repair chromatin and acetylation confusables.

name: Semaphorin 3A repulsive axon guidance and innervation
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin repulsion (CRMP, PAK, integrin), axon guidance and sympathetic innervation, distinct from Sema4D, netrin and axon-regeneration confusables.

name: TCA cycle and lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes
rationale: Members are TCA reactions plus the lipoyl-dependent PDH, OGDH, OADH and glycine-cleavage systems, protein lipoylation and DLD defects, which the electron-transport, PDH-regulation and B6 confusables lack.

name: Lung epithelial branching morphogenesis and growth
rationale: Members are lung bud elongation, branching, lobe development, growth and epithelial proliferation, distinct from alveolar-differentiation and mesenchymal-signaling confusables.

name: Inherited defects of glycogen synthesis enzymes
rationale: All members are glycogen storage diseases of the synthetic enzymes (GYS1, GYS2, GBE1, GYG1), unlike confusables about glycogenolysis, G6PC deficiencies and glucokinase.

name: Erythroid differentiation and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members are erythrocyte differentiation, enucleation, oxygen transport and erythroid-megakaryocytic programs, separating it from megakaryocyte, heme-synthesis and myeloid-progenitor confusables.

name: White adipocyte differentiation and PPAR-gamma adipose development
rationale: Members are white fat cell differentiation and proliferation, adipose development and PPAR signaling regulation, distinct from LXR lipogenesis, PPARA/circadian and brown/beige adipocyte confusables.

name: Hepatic alanine gluconeogenesis and choline-carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members combine alanine/oxaloacetate gluconeogenesis and threonine catabolism with choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis, the latter separating it from glutamate/aspartate and conjugation confusables and the former from biotin/carnitine-transport ones.

name: Factor XII-kallikrein contact activation and fibrinolysis regulation
rationale: Members are FXII/kallikrein intrinsic activation, hereditary angioedema, amyloid-FXII interaction, plasminogen activation and fibrin dissolution, unlike VWF, MMP and extrinsic/common coagulation confusables.

core: Proteasomal MHC class I antigen presentation
name: Proteasomal MHC class I antigen presentation and PD-L1 turnover
rationale: Members are proteasome assembly, class I processing and cross-presentation, viral Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and PD-L1 trafficking/degradation, the class I and PD-L1 components separating it from class II and DC-surface confusables.

name: p53-mediated G1/G2 arrest after ionizing radiation
rationale: Members are TP53 stability/phosphorylation, TP53 transcription of G1/G2 arrest genes, Cdc25A degradation and responses to X- and gamma-radiation, unlike GTSE1/MASTL mitotic progression and DNA-repair-gene confusables.

name: Amyloid-beta formation, clearance and glial activation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid-beta production, fibrillization and clearance together with astrocyte/microglia activation, glial proliferation and LTP suppression, separating it from APP-biosynthesis/tangle and microglial-differentiation confusables.

name: Xenobiotic biotransformation by CYP2E1, acetylation and methylation
rationale: Members are xenobiotic, paracetamol, alkaloid and aromatic-compound metabolism via CYP2E1, acetylation and methylation, distinct from sulfonation, glycine-conjugation and CYP1A2/FMO confusables.
